## AI slop check

**Result:** 3 phrases read as AI-written, one in each of the last three sentences. Each is marked in your draft below with a suggested fix.

### What to change

| # | Your text | Suggested fix | Why it reads as AI |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | "It is not just a feature, it is a new way of working." | Cut it: the next two sentences say what changes | False contrast: nobody called it just a feature |
| 2 | "faster, smarter, and with more confidence" | faster | Rule of three: three interchangeable benefits |
| 3 | "Moreover," | Cut it: the sentence stands on its own | Filler transition: it can go with nothing lost |

### Your draft, marked up

How to read the marks: ~~struck-through text~~ is what to change, the **bold text** after the arrow is the suggested fix, and the pattern's name is in brackets. A note starting **SLOP** applies to the paragraph below it.

---

Our new export button ships today for every workspace. ~~It is not just a feature, it is a new way of working.~~ → **cut: the next two sentences say what changes** *(#1 false contrast)* Teams can export ~~faster, smarter, and with more confidence~~ → **faster** *(#2 rule of three)*. ~~Moreover,~~ → **cut: the sentence stands on its own** *(#3 filler transition)* the export runs in the background, so nothing blocks you.
